name: Container & Kubernetes Security
tagline: Defending your own clusters: image scanning, SBOM, runtime detection, CIS posture, and admission policy.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.desc: Aqua Security's comprehensive scanner covering container images, filesystems, git repos, VMs, and Kubernetes; detects CVEs, misconfigurations, secrets, and licenses from one binary.
tools.when: Gate every image build in CI and scan at push time; add trivy-operator (or Kubescape) for in-cluster image monitoring.

tools.name: Grype
tools.desc: Anchore's fast vulnerability scanner for images, filesystems, and SBOMs; pairs with Syft and adds EPSS, KEV, and OpenVEX filtering to prioritize real risk.
tools.when: Speed-first CI scans, or scan an SBOM you already generated instead of re-pulling and re-analyzing the image.

tools.name: Syft
tools.desc: Generates SBOMs for container images, filesystems, and archives in CycloneDX, SPDX, and Syft JSON; feeds Grype directly and supports signed in-toto attestations.
tools.when: Produce a machine-readable dependency inventory at build time and ship it with the image to prove supply-chain provenance.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.desc: Cross-reference entry: `trivy image --format cyclonedx|spdx` emits SBOMs, and Trivy will also scan an existing SBOM document for vulnerabilities.
tools.when: You standardize on Trivy already and want SBOM output without introducing a second cataloging tool.

tools.name: cyclonedx-cli
tools.desc: OWASP CycloneDX CLI to validate, merge, diff, convert, sign, and verify CycloneDX and SPDX BOMs; exits non-zero on invalid input for CI gating.
tools.when: Normalize third-party vendor SBOMs into one format, diff releases to catch dependency drift, or enforce schema-valid BOMs in the pipeline.

tools.name: Falco
tools.desc: CNCF-graduated kernel monitoring agent (eBPF or driver) that watches syscalls enriched with container and Kubernetes metadata, alerting via a flexible rules engine.
tools.when: Deploy on every production node for real-time detection of shells in containers, privileged pods, and sensitive-file access.
tools.install: helm repo add falcosecurity https://falcosecurity.github.io/charts && helm install falco falcosecurity/falco

tools.name: docker-bench-security
tools.desc: Docker's CIS Docker Benchmark script auditing the Docker/containerd host, daemon, and running containers against dozens of best-practice checks.
tools.when: Harden and periodically re-audit the container host after workloads are deployed; quick compliance readout for a single host.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/docker/docker-bench-security.git && cd docker-bench-security && sudo sh docker-bench-security.sh

tools.name: Kubescape
tools.desc: CNCF-incubating Kubernetes security platform scanning clusters, manifests, Helm charts, git repos, and images against CIS, NSA-CISA, and MITRE ATT&CK; operator mode adds continuous posture and eBPF runtime.
tools.when: First full-posture sweep of a cluster and as a CI gate on manifests; install the operator for continuous compliance monitoring.

tools.name: kube-bench
tools.desc: Aqua's Go tool that runs the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark against control plane, etcd, and worker node configuration, matched to the running Kubernetes version.
tools.when: Validate a specific hardened baseline after cluster upgrades, node onboarding, or as a scheduled per-node job.

tools.name: Popeye
tools.desc: Read-only live-cluster sanitizer that lints deployed workloads for misconfigurations, dead resources, port mismatches, and missing probes, scoring overall cluster health.
tools.when: Periodic 'wide-open' sweep to catch drift and operational debt that static manifest review misses.

tools.name: kube-hunter
tools.desc: Legacy Aqua pen-test tool that finds cluster weaknesses from an attacker's perspective (exposed dashboards, leaked secrets, weak RBAC); officially no longer under active development.
tools.when: Offense-style spot check on a cluster you own; treat findings as a starting list since it is not actively maintained.

tools.name: OPA Gatekeeper
tools.desc: CNCF policy controller that enforces Rego-based policy through constraint templates and constraints, with admission webhooks, audit, and mutation support.
tools.when: Enforce registry allowlists, required labels, and security-context rules at admission when you already know Rego or want the largest policy ecosystem.

tools.name: Kyverno
tools.desc: CNCF-graduated Kubernetes-native policy engine using YAML (no new language) to validate, mutate, generate, and clean up resources; verifies image signatures via cosign.
tools.when: Teams that prefer familiar YAML and want mutation, image verification, and policy-as-a-resource without learning Rego.
tools.install: helm repo add kyverno https://kyverno.github.io/helm-charts && helm install kyverno kyverno/kyverno -n kyverno --create-namespace

tools.name: Polaris
tools.desc: Fairwinds policy-as-code with 30+ built-in checks across security, networking, reliability, and efficiency; runs as a dashboard, CI CLI, or mutating admission webhook.
tools.when: Drop-in baseline enforcement with a visible compliance dashboard when full OPA or Kyverno is overkill.

tools.name: hadolint
tools.desc: Haskell Dockerfile linter that parses the Dockerfile AST and applies best-practice rules, delegating inline shell checks to ShellCheck (DL- and SC-prefixed findings).
tools.when: Lint Dockerfiles in CI to catch untagged images, root users, and unsafe RUN commands before the image is ever built.

tools.name: dockle
tools.desc: Container image linter that audits the built image against CIS Docker image checkpoints and best practices (non-root user, HEALTHCHECK, setuid/setgid files, content trust).
tools.when: Audit the built image itself, complementing Dockerfile lint, right before pushing to a production registry.
